topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: Oh, what a queer turn of fate, neighbor. I heard your fine horse of iron was taken away, even from its own stable. A sorrowful affair, indeed, when the world turns so harsh. The soil, the beasts, and even the old oak have their troubles, but they are of the earth and find a way to rest. Mayhap, this interruption, as sudden as a spring storm, will pass, and find you stronger for the storm. Pray to St. Anthony, the finder of lost things, and perhaps your steed will return to its rightful place, under your care once more. In these trying times, know your village stands with you, as the wheat stands in the field, each stalk supporting its brother in the wind.
